The '''Back Reach''' was an area in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] that included the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Feena]] and [[Feldwes]]. Planets in the Back Reach were supplied with [[Fish/Legends|fish]], seafood, and kelp from [[Barison]].
